subject: Deployment mode & security follow-up (HIPAA, SOC2 evidence)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Kelly <j.kelly@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode & security follow-up (HIPAA, SOC2 evidence)

Hi James —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Elara's use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call recap:
- Goal: embed Redwood-powered clinical summarization into Elara's provider portal (PHI in requests).
- Volume: ~100k API requests/month initially; sporadic peak spikes tied to EHR batch runs.
- Key constraints: HIPAA compliance + BAA, SOC2 evidence for security team, and a preference for data residency in the US.

Deployment options we discussed (high level):
1) Hosted API + BAA: fastest to launch; Redwood signs a BAA and we can enable HIPAA supports. SOC2 Type II report available for your security review (attached).
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools): tenant-isolated pools, stronger logical isolation and predictable throughput; supports BYOK for encryption at rest depending on configuration.
3) Private VPC / on-prem: full network isolation, customer-managed KMS/HSM, required for some audit requirements. Longer procurement and setup timeline.

Attachments: I've attached our latest SOC2 Type II report and a BAA template for your legal team to review.

Questions / asks from our side to help qualify next steps:
- Do you have a minimum deployment mode requirement today (Hosted with BAA vs Dedicated vs Private)?
- Any hard constraints on data residency beyond "US" (specific regions/regions prohibited)?
- Does your security team require proofs beyond the SOC2 report (e.g., penetration test reports, architecture diagrams, log retention windows, specific audit evidence)?
- Who should we loop in from procurement for timeline and PO/contract logistics?

Next recommended step: 30-min technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer Marissa (CC'd) to map the exact controls your security questionnaire requires and confirm whether Hosted + BAA will satisfy Elara or if Dedicated/Private is needed. Please let me know 2-3 windows that work next week.

Thanks — happy to move quickly on any of the options.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Report_2026.pdf, BAA_Template_Redwood_v1.docx
From: James Kelly <j.kelly@elarahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & security follow-up (HIPAA, SOC2 evidence)

Neha —

Thanks for the thorough recap and for sending the SOC2 report + BAA template. A few clarifying questions from our security and procurement teams before we schedule the technical call: 

1) SOC2 evidence: do you provide SOC2 Type II only, or do you also have an ISAE/SOC crosswalk or pen-test report available? Our auditors often ask for both the SOC2 report and a recent penetration test summary.
2) Encryption: confirmation that all PHI is encrypted in transit and at rest. Is BYOK supported for hosted versus dedicated versus private? Any limitations?
3) Tenant isolation on Dedicated: can you share whether the dedicated pools are single-tenant at the VM/GPU level or still multi-tenant within a customer pool? We need to document the isolation model for our audit.
4) Data residency & logging: we require 7 years of audit log retention for certain workflows — can Redwood export or retain logs for that window, and can audit logs be pushed to our SIEM?

Procurement lead: please loop in procurement@elarahealth.com for contract/redline discussions. Our timeline target is to have a solution chosen and PO issued within 6–8 weeks, assuming no major blockers.

If you can briefly answer the above, we can share a time slot for the call.

Regards,
James Kelly
VP, IT & Security Operations
Elara Health

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Kelly <j.kelly@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & security follow-up (HIPAA, SOC2 evidence)

Hi James —

Quick answers below; happy to go deeper on the call.

1) SOC2 evidence: we can provide the SOC2 Type II report (attached). We also maintain a penetration test summary; I can pull the latest exec summary for your security team and coordinate an NDA if the PT details are needed. We have an internal ISAE/SOC crosswalk doc as well — I can share that.

2) Encryption:
- In transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced for all API traffic.
- At rest: data encrypted at rest by default.
- BYOK/KMS: Supported on Private VPC deployments (customer-managed KMS/HSM). For Dedicated capacity we can offer a managed KMS with customer key material options for some enterprise contracts — I'll confirm the exact model in the tech call (Marissa will have the config details). Hosted + BAA uses Redwood's managed keys by default; we can discuss options if you need BYOK for hosted but it may require dedicated/private.

3) Dedicated isolation: Dedicated pools are single-tenant from the inference-serving layer perspective (logical tenant isolation + dedicated GPU pools). Underlying VM orchestration may still run on shared physical hosts depending on region; we capture that detail in the architecture diagram we'll share on the call. For the strictest isolation (hardware-level separation and customer-managed networking), Private VPC / on-prem is the recommended path.

4) Logs & retention: We can retain and export audit logs for up to 7 years via our enterprise observability add-on; logs can also be streamed to your SIEM (Splunk/Datadog) via secure syslog or S3 export. We'll need to scope the retention cost in the contract.

Next steps:
- Marissa (CC) — can you propose 2x 30-min slots next week for a technical deep-dive (incl. a brief architecture diagram + any config notes for BYOK/dedicated pools)?
- James — if procurement is ready, please loop procurement@elarahealth.com and we can get legal to review BAA + standard SOW.

Happy to move fast on the docs and PT summary if helpful.

Best,
Neha

Neha / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick responses. We can do Tuesday 29 Jun at 10:00 AM PT for the technical call (Marissa/Dylan if available). Procurement (procurement@elarahealth.com) is on CC — they will send over our standard security questionnaire and contract redlines prior to the call.

A few items we'll attach for the call: security questionnaire (doc), required evidence list (audit team), and our standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA). Please confirm you received those when they come through.

If Hosted + BAA looks to satisfy our auditors after the call, we'll prefer Hosted to accelerate time-to-value; otherwise we'll evaluate Dedicated vs Private based on the controls you can demonstrate.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Regards,
James Kelly
VP, IT & Security Operations
Elara Health
